### Install prerelease snapshot packages

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/RELEASING.md

Examples for installing per-PR timestamped snapshot releases generated by the release workflow. Use pnpm dlx for binary CLI packages and pnpm add for library dependencies.

```sh
# Install a snapshot from the PR comment, e.g.:
pnpm dlx shadcn@0.0.0-beta-20260624120000          # CLI (has a bin)
pnpm add @shadcn/react@0.0.0-beta-20260624120000   # library
```

--------------------------------

### Install resources using shadcn add

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/registry/namespace.mdx

Install resources from a specific registry namespace, install multiple resources across registries, or install directly from a URL or local file path.

```bash
# Install from a specific registry
npx shadcn@latest add @v0/dashboard

# Install multiple resources
npx shadcn@latest add @acme/button @lib/utils @ai/prompt

# Install from URL directly
npx shadcn@latest add https://registry.example.com/button.json

# Install from local file
npx shadcn@latest add ./local-registry/button.json
```

### Install Tooltip manually and configure TooltipProvider

```bash

```

```tsx
import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip"

export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>
        <TooltipProvider>{children}</TooltipProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

### View shadcn init CLI options and arguments

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/(root)/cli.mdx

Lists the available flags and arguments for the init command, including template selection, component library base, presets, and monorepo configuration.

```bash
Usage: shadcn init [options] [components...]

initialize your project and install dependencies

Arguments:
  components                 names, url or local path to component

Options:
  -t, --template <template>  the template to use. (next, vite, start, react-router, laravel, astro)
  -b, --base <base>          the component library to use. (base, radix, aria)
  -p, --preset [name]        use a preset configuration
  -y, --yes                  skip confirmation prompt. (default: true)
  -d, --defaults             use default configuration: --template=next --preset=nova (default: false)
  -f, --force                force overwrite of existing configuration. (default: false)
  -c, --cwd <cwd>            the working directory. defaults to the current directory.
  -n, --name <name>          the name for the new project.
  -s, --silent               mute output. (default: false)
  --css-variables            use css variables for theming. (default: true)
  --no-css-variables         do not use css variables for theming.
  --monorepo                 scaffold a monorepo project.
  --no-monorepo              skip the monorepo prompt.
  --rtl                      enable RTL support.
  --no-rtl                   disable RTL support.
  --pointer                  enable pointer cursor for buttons.
  --no-pointer               disable pointer cursor for buttons.
  --reinstall                re-install existing UI components.
  --no-reinstall             do not re-install existing UI components.
  -h, --help                 display help for command
```

--------------------------------

### Read messages with get()

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/helpers/ai-sdk.mdx

Use `get()` to return messages from the start of the conversation. `get()` returns cloned messages and does not change the chat. It stops before the first continuation turn and throws when `count` reaches past one.

```ts
chat.get() // Every message.
chat.get(2) // The first two messages.
chat.get(0) // An empty initial conversation.
```

--------------------------------

### Define registry item target alias in files.target

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/changelog/2026-05-package-imports-target-aliases.mdx

Specify target directory aliases in registry item file definitions to place installed files into the user's configured directories. For example, @ui/ai/prompt-input.tsx installs the component under the ui/ai directory.

```json
{
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "registry/default/ai/prompt-input.tsx",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "target": "@ui/ai/prompt-input.tsx"
    }
  ]
}
```

--------------------------------

### Reading messages with chat.get()

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/helpers/tanstack-ai.mdx

Use `get()` to return cloned TanStack `UIMessage[]` values from the start of the conversation without mutating the chat.

```ts
chat.get() // Every message.
chat.get(2) // The first two messages.
chat.get(0) // An empty initial conversation.
```

### get(count?)

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/helpers/ai-sdk.mdx

Returns cloned messages from the start of the conversation. The count parameter limits the number of messages returned. Throws an error if count is negative or not an integer.

```APIDOC
## get(count?)

### Description
Returns cloned messages from the start of the conversation. The count parameter limits the number of messages returned. Throws an error if count is negative or not an integer.

### Method
get

### Parameters
- **count** (number) - Optional - The number of messages to return from the start. Must be a non-negative integer.

### Returns
UIMessage[] - An array of cloned messages.
```

### chat.get

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/helpers/ai-sdk.mdx

Returns messages from the start of the conversation. `get()` returns cloned messages and does not change the chat. It stops before the first continuation turn, since a continuation has no message without a live transcript, and throws when `count` reaches past one.

```APIDOC
## chat.get

### Description
Returns messages from the start of the conversation. `get()` returns cloned messages and does not change the chat. It stops before the first continuation turn, since a continuation has no message without a live transcript, and throws when `count` reaches past one.

### Method
chat.get

### Parameters
- **count** (number) - Optional - Number of messages to return from the start. If omitted, returns every message.

### Request Example
```ts
chat.get() // Every message.
chat.get(2) // The first two messages.
chat.get(0) // An empty initial conversation.
```
```

### Define a complex registry:block item with multiple file types

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/registry/faq.mdx

A registry-item.json example that installs a page, two components, a hook, a format-date lib, and a config file. Each file entry uses a registry type and optional target path.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json",
  "name": "hello-world",
  "title": "Hello World",
  "type": "registry:block",
  "description": "A complex hello world component",
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "registry/new-york/hello-world/page.tsx",
      "type": "registry:page",
      "target": "app/hello/page.tsx"
    },
    {
      "path": "registry/new-york/hello-world/components/hello-world.tsx",
      "type": "registry:component"
    },
    {
      "path": "registry/new-york/hello-world/components/formatted-message.tsx",
      "type": "registry:component"
    },
    {
      "path": "registry/new-york/hello-world/hooks/use-hello.ts",
      "type": "registry:hook"
    },
    {
      "path": "registry/new-york/hello-world/lib/format-date.ts",
      "type": "registry:lib"
    },
    {
      "path": "registry/new-york/hello-world/hello.config.ts",
      "type": "registry:file",
      "target": "~/hello.config.ts"
    }
  ]
}
```

### shadcn init [options] [components...]

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/(root)/cli.mdx

Initializes configuration and dependencies for an existing project, or creates a new project when provided a name. Installs required dependencies, adds the cn utility function, and configures CSS variables.

```APIDOC
## CLI Command: `shadcn init [options] [components...]`

### Description
Use the `init` command to initialize configuration and dependencies for an existing project, or create a new project with `--name`. The `init` command installs dependencies, adds the `cn` util, and configures CSS variables for the project. The `create` command is an alias for `init`.

### Syntax
```bash
shadcn init [options] [components...]
```

### Invocations
```bash
npx shadcn@latest init
npx shadcn@latest create
```

### Arguments
- **components** (string, optional) - names, url or local path to component

### Options
- **-t, --template <template>** - The template to use (next, vite, start, react-router, laravel, astro).
- **-b, --base <base>** - The component library to use (base, radix, aria).
- **-p, --preset [name]** - Use a preset configuration.
- **-y, --yes** - Skip confirmation prompt (default: true).
- **-d, --defaults** - Use default configuration: `--template=next --preset=nova` (default: false).
- **-f, --force** - Force overwrite of existing configuration (default: false).
- **-c, --cwd <cwd>** - The working directory. Defaults to the current directory.
- **-n, --name <name>** - The name for the new project.
- **-s, --silent** - Mute output (default: false).
- **--css-variables** - Use css variables for theming (default: true).
- **--no-css-variables** - Do not use css variables for theming.
- **--monorepo** - Scaffold a monorepo project.
- **--no-monorepo** - Skip the monorepo prompt.
- **--rtl** - Enable RTL support.
- **--no-rtl** - Disable RTL support.
- **--pointer** - Enable pointer cursor for buttons.
- **--no-pointer** - Disable pointer cursor for buttons.
- **--reinstall** - Re-install existing UI components.
- **--no-reinstall** - Do not re-install existing UI components.
- **-h, --help** - Display help for command.
```

### Install components via CLI

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/ai-elements/aria/chain-of-thought.mdx

Add trace, code-block, and badge components to your project using the shadcn CLI.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add trace code-block badge
```

--------------------------------

### Install resources from namespaced registries

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/(root)/components-json.mdx

Installs resources from configured public or private registries using namespaced syntax. Supports installing single or multiple resources via the shadcn CLI.

```bash
# Install from a configured registry
npx shadcn@latest add @v0/dashboard

# Install from private registry
npx shadcn@latest add @private/button

# Install multiple resources
npx shadcn@latest add @acme/header @internal/auth-utils
```

--------------------------------

### Install react-aria-components dependency

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/components/aria/sidebar.mdx

Required dependency for the sidebar component when installing manually.

```bash
npm install react-aria-components
```

--------------------------------

### Add a registry item using URL

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/registry/getting-started.mdx

Installs an item into your project using the item's direct URL to test the install flow.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add http://localhost:3000/r/button.json
```

--------------------------------

### Install Input via CLI

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/components/aria/input.mdx

Add the Input component to your project using the shadcn CLI.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add input
```

--------------------------------

### Install dependencies

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

Installs project dependencies across the workspace using pnpm.

```bash
pnpm install
```

--------------------------------

### Install project dependencies

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/(root)/_blocks.mdx

Install required workspace dependencies using pnpm.

```bash
pnpm install
```

--------------------------------

### Examples Directory Structure

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/examples/README.md

Displays the organization of demo components separated by base library along with auto-generated registry files.

```text
examples
├── base
│   ├── button-demo.tsx
│   └── ...
├── radix
│   └── ...
├── aria
│   └── ...
├── __components__   # Auto-generated by registry:build
└── __index__.tsx    # Auto-generated by registry:build
```

--------------------------------

### Fetch Component Documentation with shadcn CLI

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/changelog/2026-04-component-composition.mdx

Pulls component composition, usage, and examples into context via the command line for developers and coding agents.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest docs card
```

--------------------------------

### Install button dependency

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/components/radix/code-block.mdx

Required shadcn/ui dependency for the code-block component when installing manually.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add button
```

--------------------------------

### Install Prompt Input dependencies via CLI

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/ai-elements/aria/prompt-input.mdx

Run this command to add the input-group, attachment, and dropdown-menu components needed to build the Prompt Input.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add input-group attachment dropdown-menu
```
